biggest_catch: Points expire after 90 days of inactivity, have no cash value, and Fetch can change or remove rewards at its sole discretion.
catches: Points expire after 90 days of inactivity (60-day warning by email/text)
Receipts must be scanned within 14 calendar days of purchase
Points have no cash value and cannot be redeemed for cash, transferred, or combined
Minimum Redemption Amount can change at any time at Fetch's sole discretion
Fetch may limit the number of receipts processed in a time period
Only one account per person; fake receipts or multiple accounts lead to termination

c1.evidence: ToS identifies 'Fetch Rewards, LLC, a Delaware corporation' operating the Fetch Rewards Program via official apps/websites.

c2.evidence: ToS: 'The Fetch Rewards Program allows you to engage with our participating brands to acquire points and/or bonus points' and 'you may redeem your Points' for 'a gift card or other product offered as a Reward'.

c3.evidence: Free app; no purchase, subscription, or fee required anywhere in the ToS to earn or redeem.

c4.evidence: ToS defines redemption for gift cards/other products at the in-app rate with a Minimum Redemption Amount; the app shows the concrete minimum of 3,000 points = $3 gift card (Visa/Amazon/Target etc.).

eligibility: Must be the age of majority in your jurisdiction; not directed at children under 13. US + Puerto Rico with a US-based phone number (per official support/FAQ; ToS does not state geography).
notes: Terms page loaded live 2026-09-22 (effective May 19, 2026). The concrete 3,000-points=$3 rate is shown in the app's Rewards catalog, not in the ToS text itself. Fetch rebranded from fetchrewards.com to fetch.com; ToS still hosted on fetchrewards.com.
payout_quote: When your Points balance reaches the Minimum Redemption Amount... you may redeem your Points. Points can only be used in exchange for Rewards and have no other use or value.

s1.note: Age of majority required per ToS. US + Puerto Rico + US phone number per official FAQ/support, not stated in ToS text.

s2.note: 90-day inactivity expiry, 14-day receipt window, receipt quantity limits, no cash value, one account per person.

s3.note: ToS silent on timing; official FAQ/in-app states digital gift cards typically arrive within 72 hours.

s4.note: ToS has no fixed published point rate; rate shown in-app at redemption time.

s5.note: https://fetch.com is the official site; program operates via the official iOS/Android apps.

s6.note: Download app, create account, scan receipts, redeem at 3,000 points — all concrete and user-doable.

steps: Download the official Fetch Rewards app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store (free).
Open the app and create an account with your email (or Google/Facebook login); provide your name and a valid mobile phone number.
Optionally enter a friend's referral code on the signup screen for bonus points.
After any grocery, restaurant, gas, or retail purchase, tap the camera icon in the app and photograph the full receipt within 14 days.
Optionally link your email and Amazon accounts under the eReceipts section so online purchase receipts earn automatically.
Check the Special Offers tab for bonus-point offers on specific brands before you shop.
Once your balance reaches at least 3,000 points, open the Rewards tab, pick a gift card (e.g. $3 Amazon), tap Get My Reward, and find the gift card under My Rewards / your email.
timing: Digital gift cards typically delivered within 72 hours of redemption (per official FAQ; ToS does not state timing).

weasel_words.quote: 'Fetch does not guarantee that any particular Reward or Offer will be available on any given product for any specific user at any moment in time.' + 'Minimum Redemption Amount ... subject to change at any time at the sole discretion of Fetch.'
